name: ZenoButton
title: Zeno Button shortcuts
description: Shortcuts for the Zeno Button: `pb` presses it, and `pbe`, `pbv`, `pbn`, `pbk` and `pbi` take you to the Earth, Vegeta, Namek, Konats or Iceria vortex from anywhere (recall, press button, walk, enter vortex). Replaces the old Zeno Button module. Type `zb help`.
author: Vorrac

aliases.name: zb
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("ZenoButton") end
zb.command(matches[2] ~= "" and matches[2] or nil)
